objective: at least 100 visible tokens/s for one warmed request

system.hosts: two Apple M4 Max systems with 128 GB unified memory each
system.transport: MLX JACCL over direct Thunderbolt RDMA
system.parallelism: 128 routed experts per rank; trunk, shared experts, and DSpark replicated
system.serving: six prompt slots, six decode slots, dynamic caches, 1,048,576-token context

workload.name: exact count300
workload.warmup: one warm-up followed by three measured repeats

post_attention_head_gather.design: shard Q heads and sinks, gather head outputs before replicated output projections
post_attention_head_gather.depth_8: bit-identical across attention compression ratios 0, 4, and 128
post_attention_head_gather.full_depth: rejected; first numerical difference appeared after layer 9 attention

pre_attention_q_gather.design: column-shard segmented Q projection, gather Q projection output, then execute canonical full-head attention
pre_attention_q_gather.full_depth: 46 checkpoints exact through 43 layers, including final hidden state and logits
pre_attention_q_gather.decision: rejected for performance; one extra collective per layer outweighed projection savings

decision: retain canonical EP2; no candidate was deployed
next_gate: reduce the approximately 95.99 ms canonical cycle toward 58.4 ms without adding a latency-bound collective per layer
